title: BGP session Established but zero prefixes — inbound route-map denies all
symptom: R2-R3 eBGP session (192.0.2.2) shows Established and non-zero timers but prefix count is 0. CustA has no reachability despite the session being up.

inject.note: Applies an inbound route-map that denies all prefixes from R3. Session stays Established (TCP/BGP OK) but every received prefix is discarded.

ground_truth.root_cause: inbound route-map DENY-ALL on R2 blocks all prefixes from R3 (192.0.2.2) — session Established but zero routes admitted
ground_truth.fix: router bgp 65001 / no neighbor 192.0.2.2 route-map DENY-ALL in
ground_truth.verify: show ip bgp neighbors 192.0.2.2 shows prefix count > 0 after removing deny route-map
